_provenance.status: APP-AUTHORED example records — no work-order service or contract exists (see lib/api-client/work-orders.ts)
brief: Captain checklist (2026-09-19): the Work orders screen (/staff/work-orders) was a twelve-line stub; it is now the office's recorded maintenance and repair list.

Domain wording follows docs/04-modules/facilities-scheduling.md §38 (blueprint §38 maintenance & work orders: grass cutting · landscaping · cleaning · monument repair · lighting · pest control · drainage · tree maintenance · infrastructure; lifecycle assignment → priority → execution → inspection → close) and the field-ops service classification (docs/02-architecture/microservices.md:178).
note: WHAT THIS IS: the office's own recorded maintenance list — what needs doing, which chapel/vehicle/plot/equipment it belongs to, who is assigned, its priority, its due date and the recorded date each state moved. Work orders are a deferred property/field-ops workflow (property-gis carries lots, reservations and sales today) and no contract names a work-order record, so live mode answers 503 and only fixture mode serves these records (lib/api-client/work-orders.ts).

WHAT IT CROSS-REFERENCES (pinned by tests/fixture-contract/work-orders.test.ts): chapel and equipment refs are scheduling resources (lib/fixtures/scheduling/resources.json); vehicle refs are the dispatch fixture's fleet (lib/fixtures/operations/dispatch.json); plot refs are property lots (lib/fixtures/property/lots.json) and the label is the lot's own `lot_number`. An `assignee` with an `employee_number` is an HR directory employee (lib/fixtures/hr/employees.json); an assignee with none must be one of WORK_ORDER_TEAM_ASSIGNEES in lib/work-orders.ts — the HR directory records no grounds or maintenance staff yet, so those rows name the crew/contractor the office's own file names and the screen says so.

THE STATE IS THE HISTORY: each order's state is the last recorded movement and `moved_on` its date; the screen derives `overdue` from the recorded due date against `as_of` (the day the list was recorded) — never from a wall clock or an invented SLA. `as_of` is the only clock this fixture has.
DEMO DATA ONLY: no amount (cost, quotation, fee) appears anywhere — a work order records work, not money.
